llm.ai-maid.title: Chat with %s
llm.ai-maid.message.internal: An error occurred while reading or applying maid state. Check the current work before retrying.
llm.ai-maid.message.context_too_large: Conversation context is too large. Clear the conversation before retrying.
llm.ai-maid.thinking: Thinking… Manual command changes cancel this request.
llm.ai-maid.hint: Enter to send · Scroll for history · Closing keeps the request running
llm.ai-maid.line.action: [Server] Command accepted: %s (work is not yet complete)
llm.ai-maid.message.disabled: LLM is disabled. Configure ai-maid-llm.json on the server, then run /maid llm reload.
llm.ai-maid.message.unavailable: The maid must be alive, yours, nearby and in the same dimension.
llm.ai-maid.message.invalid_message: Messages and persona must contain 1 to 2000 characters.
llm.ai-maid.message.busy: This maid is processing a message. Cancel it before retrying.
llm.ai-maid.message.capacity: The server has reached its model request limit. Try again later.
llm.ai-maid.message.cooldown: Please wait before sending another message.
llm.ai-maid.message.stale: Request cancelled: maid, owner, range or manual command changed. Accepted actions are not undone.
llm.ai-maid.message.cancelled: Model request cancelled. Accepted game actions continue; select Stay to stop work.
llm.ai-maid.message.cleared: Conversation cleared. The maid's current work continues.
llm.ai-maid.message.reloaded: LLM service reloaded. Previous requests and conversations were cleared.
llm.ai-maid.message.config_error: Configuration could not be loaded. The existing service was retained. Check server logs and config fields.
llm.ai-maid.message.timeout: Model request timed out. Check the maid's state before retrying; accepted actions are not undone.
llm.ai-maid.message.connection: Could not connect to the model service. Check the endpoint and network.
llm.ai-maid.message.http: The model service returned an error. Check its configuration and status.
llm.ai-maid.message.http_401: Model authentication failed. Check the API key.
llm.ai-maid.message.http_403: Model access denied. Check account and model permissions.
llm.ai-maid.message.http_429: Model rate limit or quota reached. Check the quota and try later.
llm.ai-maid.message.invalid_response: Invalid, empty or truncated model response. No actions from that response were executed.
llm.ai-maid.message.response_too_large: Model response exceeded the size limit.
llm.ai-maid.message.tool_limit: Tool round limit reached. Review accepted actions before sending a new message.
llm.ai-maid.message.duplicate_call_id: Duplicate tool call ID received. The turn was stopped without repeating accepted actions.
